info.title: cl-router API
info.description: Primitive-routed inference API. Provider credentials belong exclusively to the router deployment. Runtime validation additionally enforces relational limits and asset host policy.

503.description: Router unavailable, candidates exhausted, or execution budget exhausted. Inspect error.code, retryable, and executionStarted; HTTP status alone does not determine retry safety.

post.description: Convex durable lane. Returns 202 after idempotent metadata submission; input and result remain consumer-owned. No provider replay on worker loss.
